==Biography==
Prior to playing League of Legends, kkOma played StarCraft 2 under the name "[http://wiki.teamliquid.net/starcraft2/LittleBoy LittleBoy]" and played for Team Old Generations. After unsuccessful attempts at qualifying for GSL Code A, he quit StarCraft 2 to play League of Legends for StarTale.

== Trivia ==
* He is the most successful coach in LoL history having won Worlds 5 times (2013, 2015, 2016, 2024, 2025)
* He is the winner of the "Esports Coach of the Decade" prize at the Esports Awards 2025
* His favorite champions are {{ci|Riven}} and {{ci|Shyvana}}.<ref>[http://www.thisisgame.com/board/view.php?id=1129436&board=0&category=13735&subcategory=&page=3&best=&searchmode=title&search=&orderby=&token= ''StarTale Team Interview'']</ref>
* Known for his strict attitude in terms of coaching.
